purpose: Test one point-in-time SW2021 level-one industry breadth mechanism for a three-session A-share holding protocol without sweeping industry definitions, windows, directions, or provider fields.

source_selection.chosen_source: Tushare Pro SW2021 classified index_member_all membership intervals
source_selection.historical_minute_permission_decision: Do not purchase the separate CNY 2000 per year historical-minute entitlement for this branch; first test a lower-cost independent industry cross-section available under the existing account.
source_selection.why_this_source: The provider exposes membership admission and removal dates, permitting point-in-time industry assignment rather than a current-classification backfill. The mechanism aggregates peer directions and is distinct from another stock-level OHLC window, Tushare classified moneyflow, and PB.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: Broad participation across other seasoned members of the same level-one industry may persist for the next three sessions more reliably than one stock's own return.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_existing_stock_momentum: The stock's own sign is removed from every daily industry numerator and denominator. A mandatory no-return rank-correlation screen must still reject the factor if its resulting ranks are a near synonym of any prior factor.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_existing_tushare_mechani: This membership-only source requests no moneyflow, PB, price, market-cap, turnover, limit, concept, heat, or return field.

source.membership_request_mode: one SW2021 level-one code and one is_new value per call

point_in_time_membership_policy.active_interval: in_date <= local_session and (out_date is missing or local_session <= out_date)
point_in_time_membership_policy.is_new_semantics: Y and N are fetched separately and retained as source audit context; interval dates, not is_new alone, determine historical membership.
point_in_time_membership_policy.missing_out_date_policy: allowed only for is_new=Y and interpreted as still active

factor.name: sw1_three_session_leave_one_out_breadth
factor.one_session_peer_direction: peer_return = close_t / close_t_minus_1 - 1; peer_up = 1 when peer_return > 0 else 0
factor.daily_formula: For stock i and its active SW2021 L1 industry g on session t: (sum(peer_up for valid seasoned members of g) - peer_up_i) / (count(valid seasoned members of g) - 1).
factor.three_session_formula: Arithmetic mean of the exact daily leave-one-out breadth on t, t-1, and t-2; all three values are required.
factor.candidate_quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY, effective only after the next local session following announcement and no older than 550 days

required_checks_before_full_sync: the environment supplies TUSHARE_TOKEN without logging its value
classification response contains only the frozen fields and only unique SW2021 L1 codes
both representative membership responses stay below the documented 2000-row ceiling
membership response contains only the frozen fields and the requested L1 code and is_new value
stock codes, industry codes, in_date, out_date, and current/historical flags satisfy the frozen point-in-time rules
current and historical representative rows are both present
no credential, name, price, amount, valuation, concept, heat, factor value, or return field is requested or stored
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write a no-return rejection record and stop without a full membership sync, factor construction, price access, parameter change, another classification vendor, or purchase recommendation

full_snapshot_contract.enumeration: use every unique code returned by the accepted SW2021 L1 classification response and fetch both Y and N membership rows

uniqueness.comparison_scope: the accepted 43 close-known technical/quality fields plus the terminal Tushare classified-moneyflow and positive-book-to-market raw factors

no_return_gates.failed_gate_policy: stop without forward returns, inversion, another breadth window, L2/L3 substitution, peer threshold change, current-membership backfill, industry price momentum, concept data, moneyflow, heat, a year subset, or combination with rejected factors
